events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the fix commit is on main and pushed, and look for publish holds
events.input: $ git branch --contains 729da61 2>&1 | head -5; git remote -v | head -4; git fetch origin main -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 729da61 origin/main && echo "729da61 on origin/main" || echo "729da61 NOT on origin/main"; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; git diff --stat -- app/src/app/onboarding/onboarding-client.tsx app/scripts/run-chain.sh | tail -3; grep -n -i "publish held\|publish hold" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect audit header, open P0 rows and the publish chain script
events.input: $ grep -c "" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md; sed -n 1,12p /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-600; echo ---; grep -E "\| P0 \|" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | awk -F'|' '{s=$(NF-1); print $2 "|" substr(s,1,70)}' | grep -i -E "\|\s*(open|partly|tracked)" | head -20; echo ---; ls app/scripts/.t197* ; grep -n -i "mirror\|publish\|wrangler" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -20
